items.docs: Lists all tags defined for your Qualio instance. Tags are company-wide labels used to categorise and filter entities such as documents and quality events, and can also gate access to private documents. Each tag has an id and a name; the returned ids are the same tag ids that appear on documents and events, so use this endpoint to resolve a tag name to its id (or vice versa).
